trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric

We exhibit a specific connection and directly compute its curvature, demonstrating that it satisfies the $\star_q$-self-duality condition required for a categorical instanton.' The narration is also inaccurate: the body computes no curvature (it observes $F_{\nabla_0}=0$) and invokes no deformation theory (it cites categorical descent of BPST). Same two-sentence template recurs across the exists/unique proof blocks of this chapter.
